# Harness Skills And Adoption Evidence

Status: design. Source inspection: 2026-09-08.

Observer proposal connects a versioned harness method and skill package to a task, retained result, limitations and adoption receipt. Replay, adaptation, independent checking and unresolved failures remain distinguishable; counts do not automatically grant reputation or permission.

An adoption path is proposed; this batch claims no fresh benchmark result or accepted contribution.
